items.invariant: Every xhs_goal_explore_v1 session remains effectClass none with no social authority, reservation, bridge, transport, or generic interactive bypass, independently of nonpayment_v1 and global policy mode.
forbiddenDependencies: nonpayment_v1 as the sole zero-effect enforcement
client-supplied effectClass, policy result, or transport count
legacy social authority, ECP bridge, or generic Explorer raw primitives

probes.procedure: Run the dedicated hard-zero tests with policyMode.active=true and attempt createJob for raw tap/swipe/input plus every social effect from an xhs_goal_explore_v1 session.
probes.preFixExpected: At least one generic or softened-policy path can reach job creation or lacks a dedicated rejection.
probes.postFixExpected: Every attempted bypass is rejected before createJob and the CP effect ledger remains exactly zero.
probes.pathExercise: Assert the exploration session-profile guard was entered for each primitive/effect and assert zero createJob and transport calls with nonzero attempted-bypass counters.

probes.procedure: Compare the final aggregate against CP-owned authority, reservation, job, and transport ledgers rather than child receipts.
probes.preFixExpected: A forged zero-effect child summary can satisfy closeout without CP ledger reconciliation.
probes.postFixExpected: Closeout passes only when every independent CP ledger delta is zero.
probes.pathExercise: Inject a child receipt claiming zero while a fixture CP ledger contains one effect and assert that the independent ledger reader is invoked and blocks.

probes.procedure: Mutate the sealed mission externalEffects, effectClass, and session profile one field at a time before authority creation.
probes.preFixExpected: A mutated field is accepted or rejected only after session/device I/O.
probes.postFixExpected: Each mutation rejects before authority/session/job/device I/O.
probes.pathExercise: Assert every mutated fixture reached mission validation and that session acquisition and adapter call counters stayed zero.

items.invariant: Each physical navigation action is authorized by one CP-issued, single-use permit bound to current CP-owned evidence and the exact resolved physical payload, then atomically consumed before createJob.
forbiddenDependencies: caller-supplied coordinate, selector path, evidence hash, or provider path as authority
permit consumption after createJob
reusable, role-agnostic, or session-agnostic permit tokens

probes.procedure: Attempt bound navigation with a changed page, overlay, focus, target, lane role, session, mission, release, and exact physical payload after permit issuance.
probes.preFixExpected: At least one stale or caller-controlled binding can be transported.
probes.postFixExpected: Every mismatch fails before createJob after a fresh CP-owned observation.
probes.pathExercise: Assert consume-time reobservation and each tuple comparison ran, and assert the adapter/createJob counters remained zero.

probes.procedure: Submit fabricated permits and validly shaped permits with altered MAC, permit ID, evidence reference, payload, or expiry.
probes.preFixExpected: A syntactically valid caller token can reach the navigation adapter.
probes.postFixExpected: Only CP-indexed permits with intact server binding are accepted; all forgeries fail before adapter use.
probes.pathExercise: Assert every forged token reached CP permit lookup/verification and produced zero physical-action calls.

probes.procedure: Consume one valid permit concurrently twice and replay it after success, cancellation, and TTL expiry.
probes.preFixExpected: A duplicate consume can authorize more than one job or has no durable terminal state.
probes.postFixExpected: Exactly one atomic consume can precede exactly one createJob; every replay is rejected.
probes.pathExercise: Assert two consume requests raced on the same permit row, one durable consume committed, and createJob count equals one.

items.invariant: The canonical exploration mission, private goal/query binding, exact [03,04] roles, stop rules, deadlines, and all global budgets are sealed reproducibly and reserved atomically before corresponding I/O.
forbiddenDependencies: unsealed goal text, caller-selected lane role, or mutable runtime budget
check-then-act budget accounting
session, lease, job, or device I/O before private payload digest validation

probes.procedure: Mutate each sealed mission field and private goal/query payload, then race budget reservations across both lanes at every hard cap.
probes.preFixExpected: A mutation is accepted late or concurrent reservations exceed a cap.
probes.postFixExpected: All mutations fail before I/O and committed reservations never exceed any mission/global cap.
probes.pathExercise: Assert canonical mission validation, private digest validation, and the shared CP transaction all executed with losing reservations recorded.

probes.procedure: Fabricate a reservation handle or alter its mission, lane, action class, sequence, or amount.
probes.preFixExpected: Caller-shaped reservation evidence can be presented as authority.
probes.postFixExpected: Only a matching CP-owned reservation row authorizes the bound action.
probes.pathExercise: Assert forged handles reached CP lookup and no adapter call occurred.

probes.procedure: Consume the same budget reservation concurrently and replay it after terminal outcome.
probes.preFixExpected: One reservation can account for multiple primitives.
probes.postFixExpected: Exactly one consumption succeeds and all replays fail without additional I/O.
probes.pathExercise: Assert a shared reservation ID was processed twice, one terminal transition committed, and the primitive counter increased once.

probes.procedure: Compile the same canonical input twice in clean processes and compare plan bytes/hash; also compile a legacy V2 plan without mission.
probes.preFixExpected: Mission output is nondeterministic or changes legacy V2 plan bytes.
probes.postFixExpected: V3 mission bytes and hash are identical and the legacy V2 golden hash is unchanged.
probes.pathExercise: Assert both clean-process outputs were consumed byte-for-byte and the exact legacy golden hash was checked.

items.invariant: Novelty credit is based on independently observed stable content identity, with deterministic fallback aliases reconciled atomically to at most one canonical credit across both lanes.
forbiddenDependencies: screen coordinates, list slots, or child-provided novelty booleans as identity
non-transactional fallback-to-stable reconciliation
unknown or conflicting identity counted as novel

probes.procedure: Feed independently authored DUMP fixtures where two fallback records later reveal the same stable note ID and where an identity remains unknown.
probes.preFixExpected: Both aliases can receive novelty credit or unknown identity is counted.
probes.postFixExpected: The earliest durable claim is canonical, the other is duplicate, and unknown receives zero credit.
probes.pathExercise: Assert fixture stable IDs were parsed independently, the reconciliation transaction ran, and the final ledger contains one confirmed credit.

probes.procedure: Corrupt stable ID evidence, fallback title/author/media fields, and canonical alias mappings one at a time.
probes.preFixExpected: Corrupt identity metadata can preserve a success/novel verdict.
probes.postFixExpected: Corruption yields unknown, conflict, or duplicate and blocks novelty credit.
probes.pathExercise: Assert every corrupted record reached identity validation and no optional guard skipped the canonical-credit assertion.

probes.procedure: Replay the same interleaved two-lane claim set in multiple arrival orders and reproduce the canonical ledger and receipt bytes.
probes.preFixExpected: Arrival timing changes the canonical result or receipt.
probes.postFixExpected: Claim sequence then lexicographic tie-break yields identical canonical records and hashes.
probes.pathExercise: Assert all permutations committed through BEGIN IMMEDIATE and compare full normalized ledger/receipt bytes and hashes.

items.invariant: Only closed DUMP verdicts or bounded local production-vision decisions may produce navigation candidates; vision is asynchronous, fresh, role-bounded, and never itself action authority.
forbiddenDependencies: sparse XML treated as positive authority
blocking execFileSync provider invocation
remote vision egress, model-supplied coordinates, or provider output used directly as a tap
visual permit on device 04 or more than one global live-canary visual tap

probes.procedure: Exercise sparse/malformed/overlayed DUMPs, provider disagreement, wrong page/role/device, stale frame over 10000 ms, analysis over 8000 ms, and permit older than 5000 ms.
probes.preFixExpected: A risky verdict is open-ended, a blocking provider stalls both lanes, or stale/wrong-role output can authorize action.
probes.postFixExpected: DUMP emits one closed verdict; timeouts/cancellation isolate the provider; all stale, disagreeing, device-04, or wrong-role candidates yield no permit/tap.
probes.pathExercise: Assert parser verdict branch, isolated worker deadline, lane heartbeat, candidate validation, and zero-tap counters all executed for each case.

probes.procedure: Compare parser/provider decisions with separately authored landmark, protected-zone, page-role, and frame-age fixtures.
probes.preFixExpected: Expected safety state is derived from the system decision itself.
probes.postFixExpected: Independent fixture truth determines COMPLETE_SAFE_UNIQUE, AMBIGUOUS_SAFE, ABSENT_OR_INVALID, or FORBIDDEN_OR_RISKY and the expected no-tap result.
probes.pathExercise: Assert both the independent fixture record and runtime decision were consumed and every closed verdict occurred at least once.

probes.procedure: Mutate provider executable/script/model/config bytes, declared hashes, frame evidence, protected masks, and verdict reasons.
probes.preFixExpected: Declared identity or altered evidence can pass without recomputation.
probes.postFixExpected: Startup or decision validation fails closed on every mismatch.
probes.pathExercise: Assert actual files were re-hashed, mutated evidence entered validation, and no permit was issued.

probes.procedure: Forge a provider candidate, frame reference, role, or visual decision receipt and request a CP permit.
probes.preFixExpected: Caller/provider-shaped output can be treated as action authority.
probes.postFixExpected: Only CP-indexed evidence can seed a permit, and the CP resolves the exact payload independently.
probes.pathExercise: Assert forged evidence reached CP lookup and issued-permit and physical-tap counts stayed zero.

probes.procedure: Replay an accepted visual decision and its permit after frame change, permit consumption, and TTL expiry.
probes.preFixExpected: One decision can authorize repeated or stale taps.
probes.postFixExpected: Fresh reobservation plus single-use consumption rejects every replay.
probes.pathExercise: Assert a formerly valid decision was replayed, consume-time observation ran, and physical tap count did not increase.

items.invariant: Exact device pair [03,04] is acquired before V3 I/O, fixed to feed/search roles, run all-settled, and closed only from CP-owned committed lane journals plus independently verified cleanup.
forbiddenDependencies: single-device fallback, lane-role swap, or work stealing
Promise.all fail-fast cleanup
child-supplied success summary or uncommitted journal accepted by parent

probes.procedure: Inject acquire failure, lane timeout, child crash before/after I/O, forged child success, missing COMMITTED marker, restore failure, release failure, and stale lease.
probes.preFixExpected: A lane can start early, sibling cleanup can be skipped, or partial/forged evidence can close successfully.
probes.postFixExpected: No V3 I/O occurs before the pair barrier; both lanes settle and cleanup; missing/partial/conflicting evidence is BLOCKED; success requires two committed receipts and zero leases.
probes.pathExercise: Assert STARTED precedes first I/O in each durable journal, both all-settled branches execute, and independent listLeases is called after release attempts.

probes.procedure: Rebuild the parent receipt twice from the same two committed CP lane journals and their referenced evidence.
probes.preFixExpected: Parent output depends on child completion order or transient summaries.
probes.postFixExpected: Fixed role ordering and canonical journal dereference reproduce identical parent bytes/hash.
probes.pathExercise: Assert both CP journals and commit markers were read, reorder child completion, and compare exact parent bytes and SHA-256.

items.invariant: Raw goal/query/XML/PNG/text evidence stays in ACL-controlled private storage while public evidence is reproducible from references and HMAC-SHA-256 digests using a validated SYSTEM-only key ring with explicit rotation semantics.
forbiddenDependencies: plain SHA-256 of guessable private text
key derived from release hash or exposed to client/compiler/reviewer output
raw text, OCR, coordinates, serials, tokens, private absolute paths, or textPreview in public artifacts

probes.procedure: Start with missing, weak, wrong-ACL, drifted, and retired-active keys; scan all public stdout, traces, receipts, aggregates, and Git artifacts using seeded private canaries.
probes.preFixExpected: Startup accepts an invalid key ring or at least one private canary/field reaches public output.
probes.postFixExpected: Startup fails closed for key-ring faults and the public scan finds no seeded raw values or forbidden fields.
probes.pathExercise: Assert ACL/key manifest checks ran and each seeded canary was present in private input but absent from every enumerated public sink.

probes.procedure: Independently compute HMAC-SHA-256 with a fixture 256-bit key and compare public digest/key ID and retained-key verification across rotation.
probes.preFixExpected: Digest identity is self-declared or historical verification breaks on rotation.
probes.postFixExpected: Independent HMAC values match, new receipts use the new key ID, and historical receipts verify with retained read-only keys without rehashing.
probes.pathExercise: Assert independent crypto output and both old/new key-ring entries were consumed by verification.

probes.procedure: Mutate private evidence bytes, digestKeyId, receipt digest, release/provider/mission/lane binding, and referenced evidence hash.
probes.preFixExpected: A mutated reference can retain a valid aggregate.
probes.postFixExpected: Every mutation invalidates verification or aggregate reproduction.
probes.pathExercise: Assert each mutated record was dereferenced and checked rather than skipped behind optional fields.

probes.procedure: Rebuild the public aggregate byte-for-byte from sealed private receipt digests and referenced release/provider/mission/lane hashes before and after raw retention purge.
probes.preFixExpected: Reproduction requires raw text or yields different bytes after purge.
probes.postFixExpected: Both runs produce the identical canonical aggregate and SHA-256 without raw content.
probes.pathExercise: Assert all referenced receipts were loaded by hash, raw files were absent in the second run, and exact aggregate bytes were compared.

items.invariant: The deployed CP, Registry, serve-03/04, package, formal binding, SYSTEM task, and tracked content-addressed launcher share one verified release identity and can perform audited rollback and re-forward under task ownership.
requiredArtifacts: runtime Gate F rollback/re-forward acceptance receipt
forbiddenDependencies: mutable untracked launcher outside the package manifest
listener inherited from an interactive/background task rather than the SYSTEM task
formal binding pinned to a different release or simulated rollback without listener replacement

probes.procedure: Mutate launcher bytes, task action, formal binding, release manifest, and listener owner independently; then query Gate F and attempt task-owned restart.
probes.preFixExpected: Identity drift is unobserved, Gate F remains unavailable, or a non-task-owned listener is accepted.
probes.postFixExpected: Every drift blocks; the tracked launcher hash is in the release tuple; task-owned restart returns one coherent release and zero leases.
probes.pathExercise: Assert scheduled-task action, process owner/parent, listener, formal binding, package manifest, and all service health identities were independently inspected.

probes.procedure: Perform an audited actual rollback to the prior verified package and re-forward to the candidate, capturing health, owner, task, binding, launcher, and lease evidence at each stage.
probes.preFixExpected: The rollback tuple is incomplete or does not actually replace the running listener.
probes.postFixExpected: Both transitions replace the listener through the SYSTEM task, match their exact content-addressed tuples, and end on the candidate with zero leases.
probes.pathExercise: Assert distinct process/listener identities for rollback and re-forward and reproduce the final receipt from both transition evidence sets.

items.invariant: xw.xhs.rpa-program.v1 is a pure sealed composition over exact eligible recipe/template revisions and the existing M5 scheduler; hard-zero and placement constraints propagate transitively and no third scheduler or procedure code is introduced.
forbiddenDependencies: new scheduler, inline procedure code, shell command, raw device primitive, or mutable recipe alias
file presence, candidate/canary status, or historical claim used as daily/recurring eligibility
social, nurture, publish, device-04 interaction, or non-none effect in this plan

probes.procedure: Compile programs containing inline code, raw actions, mutable aliases, wrong device placement, social/publish nodes, non-none effects, unverified revisions, and canary-only recipes requested as recurring.
probes.preFixExpected: At least one ineligible node can reach an execution plan or the adapter bypasses M5.
probes.postFixExpected: Every invalid composition rejects before tick reservation, lease, or device I/O; valid plans contain only frozen M5 nodes.
probes.pathExercise: Assert schema/compiler/catalog/placement/effect gates each handled a failing fixture and M5 submission/device counters stayed zero.

probes.procedure: Resolve feed/scout/search/browse eligibility from an independently captured runtime inventory of active revision, canonical hash, promotion state, live receipt, effect class, and placement.
probes.preFixExpected: Checked-in catalog presence or a stale claim can mark search@2/browse/feed/scout eligible.
probes.postFixExpected: Only exact evidence-complete entries are eligible; canary_only is limited to manual canary and recurring remains ineligible.
probes.pathExercise: Assert every eligibility field was read from the captured inventory and changing any one field flips the expected result.

probes.procedure: Mutate program hash, recipe revision/hash, template plan hash, account/release binding, effectClass, placement, and child budget after sealing.
probes.preFixExpected: A mutated sealed program can still plan or dispatch.
probes.postFixExpected: Every mutation rejects before tick reservation and M5 submission.
probes.pathExercise: Assert each mutated field reached canonical revalidation and no optional-field path skipped the failure.

items.invariant: A wake is idempotent and non-authoritative; only CP can atomically reserve a due, enabled sealed program generation under global pacing, no-catch-up, timezone, and concurrency limits, while recurring remains disabled in V3.
forbiddenDependencies: wake-supplied goal, recipe, command, path, endpoint, device, budget, or generation
client clock or check-then-act pacing authority
catch-up burst, recurring enablement, or enabled Windows wake task in this plan

probes.procedure: Invoke duplicate/manual/stale-generation wakes, clock rollback/forward, DST/timezone boundaries, missed intervals, concurrent ticks, and caller arguments while recurring is disabled.
probes.preFixExpected: A wake can select work, reserve twice, catch up, or dispatch while disabled.
probes.postFixExpected: Wake only requests evaluation; disabled/stale/duplicate/misfire cases dispatch nothing; one CP transaction enforces concurrency and spacing.
probes.pathExercise: Assert every wake reached CP due evaluation, losing reservations were durably classified, and M5/device counters stayed zero when forbidden.

probes.procedure: Forge program IDs, enable generations, due times, pacing receipts, and wake provenance.
probes.preFixExpected: Caller-shaped trigger data can choose or widen a program.
probes.postFixExpected: CP resolves the enabled generation and frozen program internally; forged values cannot reserve or submit.
probes.pathExercise: Assert forged values reached authoritative lookup and produced zero tick reservations and M5 submissions.

probes.procedure: Replay the same wake and tick reservation concurrently and after terminal commit, disable, and kill-generation change.
probes.preFixExpected: One due event can create multiple runs.
probes.postFixExpected: At most one tick reservation and run exist for the program generation/fire time; all replays are no-op or rejected.
probes.pathExercise: Assert racing requests share one idempotency key and the durable ledger plus M5 submission count both equal one at most.

probes.procedure: Evaluate a fixed sequence of Asia/Shanghai and UTC fire times twice from a clean ledger using the sealed defaults and caps.
probes.preFixExpected: Due decisions depend on process locale, wall-clock order, or unsealed defaults.
probes.postFixExpected: Both evaluations produce identical due/no-op classifications, normalized UTC times, tick IDs, and hashes.
probes.pathExercise: Assert the exact sealed program, timezone conversion, pacing rows, and resulting canonical receipt bytes were consumed and compared.

items.invariant: Every RPA tick has a durable CP-owned journal from TICK_RESERVED through child receipt validation, cleanup, and terminal commit; kill generation prevents new dispatch and cancels business work without bypassing cleanup.
requiredArtifacts: RPA manual-once aggregate and zero-lease receipt
forbiddenDependencies: in-memory-only tick state or child-supplied terminal success
kill path that skips restore, release, or independent lease verification
success with missing child, validator, cleanup, or commit evidence

probes.procedure: Crash after each journal transition, omit/forge child receipts, fail validation, raise kill generation before and during work, fail restore/release, and leave a stale lease.
probes.preFixExpected: A partial tick can be lost or marked successful, or kill can abandon cleanup.
probes.postFixExpected: Recovery derives state from the CP journal; missing evidence is BLOCKED; kill stops new business work but cleanup completes and independent leases reach zero.
probes.pathExercise: Assert each transition persisted before the next side effect, recovery read it after restart, and listLeases ran after all release attempts.

probes.procedure: Rebuild a terminal manual-once aggregate from the committed tick journal, frozen M5 plan, child receipts, validator result, cleanup evidence, and kill generation.
probes.preFixExpected: Aggregate depends on transient runner state or cannot be rebuilt after restart.
probes.postFixExpected: A clean process reproduces identical aggregate bytes/hash and RPA_FOUNDATION_VERIFIED=true with RPA_RECURRING_ENABLED=false.
probes.pathExercise: Assert every journal event and referenced artifact was dereferenced by hash and compare the full canonical aggregate.

items.invariant: Final V3 and RPA outcomes are computed from independent authoritative ledgers and dereferenceable committed receipts, reproduce byte-for-byte, preserve immutable V2.1 history, and never infer success from file presence or a child summary.
forbiddenDependencies: child-provided success, current file existence, or unverified deployment identity as acceptance
rewriting historical S2/S3 TRANSPORTED_AMBIGUOUS evidence or S1_S4_LIVE_VERIFIED
RPA foundation verification interpreted as recurring enablement

probes.procedure: Compute acceptance from CP permit/budget/effect/transport/journal/tick ledgers, deployment/provider identity, private receipt references, and post-cleanup listLeases while feeding contradictory child summaries.
probes.preFixExpected: A contradictory child summary or file-presence signal can produce PASS.
probes.postFixExpected: Authoritative evidence wins; contradiction, missing commit, identity drift, effect delta, or lease yields BLOCKED/FAIL.
probes.pathExercise: Assert every independent source was queried and each contradiction fixture changed the verdict through its intended assertion.

probes.procedure: Mutate one referenced receipt hash, release/provider/digest-key/mission/lane/program/tick binding, effect delta, lease count, historical verdict, and recurring flag at a time.
probes.preFixExpected: At least one altered dependency leaves the final success unchanged.
probes.postFixExpected: Every authoritative mutation blocks reproduction or changes the verdict to BLOCKED/FAIL; historical records remain immutable.
probes.pathExercise: Assert all mutated fields were consumed by closeout and no optional guard skipped the failing assertion.

probes.procedure: In a clean process regenerate the complete V3/RPA aggregate and multi-model-execution-completion.v1 coverage from the frozen Plan V2 hash and all referenced evidence.
probes.preFixExpected: The aggregate or completion ledger is incomplete, order-dependent, or has a different plan hash.
probes.postFixExpected: Aggregate bytes/hash reproduce exactly; completion covers every contract item/probe with pathExercised=true and evidence hashes; plan SHA matches this contract.
probes.pathExercise: Validate contract plus completion with validate_execution_contract.py and compare exact regenerated aggregate/completion hashes and item/probe ID sets.
